claim: Check what a snapshot really holds at intake: archive labels can be wrong, empty banks show the game's limit, and a dump saved mid-routine may leave no tail place.

evidence.text: The archive's 48K-128K label is true only of the tape; the .z80 is a 48K dump with no music, and the tape's last block loads only on a 128K machine.
Banks 3, 4, 6 are empty and bank 7 nearly so: check which banks are zero at intake; a multiload game on a snapshot is one level.
A 128K dump saved mid-routine (SP inside the plotter's data) leaves no tail place; an alternate dump saved at the title was used.
A block snapshot starts at the rewind tape prompt.
